svg.title: The rub test on a forearm with brown skin, in five pictures. 1: paint a small patch, here a cyan stripe with a pink line and white dots, and let it dry. 2: set it with a mist of setting spray or a dusting of translucent powder and wait 10 minutes. 3: press a clean tissue on it, then rub it gently with a fingertip five times. Good: the tissue stays almost clean and the edges stay sharp. Avoid: color comes off on the tissue and the patch smears; prep and set more carefully next time.
